title: Not Too Bad
text: I was concerned with this being the first box of Smuggler's Bounty coming from Amazon but it wasn't too bad. The main item was a fantastic Movie Moment POP! scene of Boba Fett looking over a freshly frozen Han Solo in carbonite - awesome. Also in the box was a 'mystery' mini of Chewbacca carrying a partially assembled C-3PO on his back and wielding a blaster - very nice. There was also an old school vinyl Lando Calrission keychain - not even in POP! form and not so impressive. It would have been better to have the keychain in POP! form or for them to have continued the patch or pin that we became accustomed to in the boxes previously. For the failure on the keychain that could have been better and not doing the patch or pin this box gets 3 stars - if either of these had been done it would easily of been a 4 or 5 star box. I'm keeping my subscription in hopes of improvement!
label: neutral
